note: An owner authorization to adopt deterministic generated state for four routes, so a future regeneration does not have to rediscover the decision. It creates no commercial approval: every gate these routes were refused at before, they are refused at after.
decisionSource: Owner decision during the Grade A 1.1 denominator reconciliation.
decisionText: For these four routes only, adopt the deterministic regenerated state: routeKind guidance_only becomes factory_v2 with renderer packet_document_v1, and the stale "no renderer" blocker is removed where current generated authority proves rendering capability. This is a correction of stale generated technical state, not the creation of a new commercial route. All four were already members of the controlling paid_packet_intended denominator before this work, and regeneration does not change that denominator. Current deterministic generation proves the packet renderer exists and produces bytes, so keeping guidance_only solely because the committed registry is stale would misrepresent present technical capability. Grade A commercial authority remains separate and fail-closed.
commercialEffect: None. All four remain commercially refused until the remaining Grade A gates independently pass.
whyTheArtifactsWereStale: The factory_v2 route registry had been short by five rows, and the witness answer sets, the paid-pathway legal join and the Session A evidence packet were short by the same five. The launch graph's own one-denominator check had been refusing to build because of it. The five were previously omitted from stale derived witness and evidence artifacts; they were not added to the paid product universe, which stood at 267 before this work and stands at 267 after it.
